incident.detail: First batch POST returned HTTP 546 WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMIT after inserting the first 6 articles. The one-by-one retry then re-inserted those 6, which the endpoint stored with a -2 suffix (duplicates). 2 articles (dr-congo, portugal) inserted once and are clean.
incident.manual_cleanup_needed: Delete one copy of each of the 6 duplicated stories from public.articles (e.g. remove the 6 '-2' rows, or the 6 base-slug rows). No delete endpoint is available to the agent.
incident.prevention: Publish one article per request (publish_run.py), never batch, to avoid partial-insert duplicates.
